title: McMoneagle's JPL correspondence and life on Mars as an open secret

tellings.quote: he's basically implying to me that it's an open secret at Jet Propulsion Lab that there was life on Mars

plain: It is an open secret at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, NASA's space research center in Pasadena, California, that there was once life on Mars, according to what Michels says Joe McMoneagle, a man known for remote viewing, the practice of trying to perceive distant places with the mind, implied to him. Michels relays this himself in a 2025 episode about life on Mars, and if true it would mean space scientists quietly know more than they say.
